management_steps.details: Oral drops, 25 mg/mL (provides approx. 1 mg elemental iron per 0.04 mL, or 25 mg elemental iron per mL).
Oral, 0.6 mL daily (provides approx. 15 mg elemental iron) until 6 months of age.
Prophylaxis for infants from 6 weeks if < 2.5 kg at birth.
